user.title: PulseAudio server
user.description: The server must accept TCP connections (module-native-protocol-tcp, or tcp address of pipewire-pulse).

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the PulseAudio server, e.g. host.docker.internal when Home Assistant runs in Docker on the same host.
data_description.port: TCP port of the native protocol (4713 by default).

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The host cannot be changed, only the port. Add a new entry for another server.

user.description: A room is a PulseAudio sink (e.g. a remap-sink on one channel of a multichannel sound card). It gets a volume, a mute and one switch per source.

error.already_configured: This sink is already used by another room.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The PulseAudio server is not connected, rooms can't be edited right now.

user.description: A source (e.g. the monitor of a null-sink a player writes to) gets a switch in every room to play it there.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The PulseAudio server is not connected, sources can't be edited right now.
